sara_ml: Heads up: onboarding whorl-9b (encoder-decoder) today. initial float32 runs look fine but after q4_0 quant we see an off-by-one in KV alignment causing weird hallucinations on long context.
raj: can you paste a short repro prompt and the runtime error/snippet?
sara_ml: repro prompt: 'Summarize the events in chapter 12 of the file...' . runtime log: `kv_index mismatch at step 512: expected 768 got 769`
tom_runtime: hmm, encoder-decoder with per-head rotary offsets; we've seen rotaries that assume autoregressive offsets. ED models require different RoPE handling for cross-attn. are you running runtime in encoder-decoder mode or forcing decode-only path?
sara_ml: runtime is using decode mode for generation but we call cross-attn with encoder outputs. suspect q4 packing changed token layout. quant config used: `--quant q4_0 --group-size 128 --pack-kv true`
raj: quick check: try disabling pack-kv or set `--group-size 1` to rule out packing alignment.
sara_ml: tried pack-kv=false and the issue disappears. with pack-kv=true fail rate ~40% on long contexts (>4k tokens).
tom_runtime: that narrows it. pack-kv interacts with rotary stride for split-kv layouts. can you run `dump_kv_meta()` on a failing trace and paste the metadata?
sara_ml: pasted snippet: `KV_META: head_stride=64, token_stride=1, rot_offset=0x1f`. also observed rot_offset flips between encoder and decoder stages in the failing traces.
eva_ops: would this affect current Dedicated customers? any fast mitigation?
tom_runtime: mitigation: force pack-kv off for ED models, or apply runtime flag `--rotary-mode split-encoder-decoder` (patched on staging). pushing a hotfix now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/rotary-fix v2026.3.14 -> staging (job 4821).
raj: :thumbsup: also can we add a unit test that simulates pack-kv + q4 packing with ED attention shapes to prevent regressions?
sara_ml: on it. I'll add a fuzz test and a small golden-output check vs float32.
tom_runtime: please also add a line in the model-onboard checklist: `check pack-kv with encoder-decoder + quant` and link to quant rules doc.
sara_ml: added note in PR #2314, pinging for review.
